paper.framing: controlled-stack theory plus a failed language-model applicability gate
paper.selection_rule: No merged model may be materialized while computing scores or selecting a graft.

selected_local_compatibility_fallback.selection_rationale: The requested Qwen3-1.7B and exact Qwen2.5-1.5B revisions are not cached. This is the only cached 1B-2B Qwen decoder candidate, loads successfully on the pinned RTX 3060 Ti, and is recorded as an explicit compatibility fallback rather than silently relabeled.

base_model.architecture_requirement: open multilingual decoder with a shared tokenizer and an addressable sequential decoder-block stack

preflight.requested_candidates: not_cached; outbound Hugging Face traffic is disabled
preflight.selected_candidate_load: passed; 2.88 GiB bfloat16 model footprint on GPU
preflight.prohibited_resolution: Do not substitute a from-scratch toy model for Tier-A evidence.

matching.base_checkpoint: identical content hash and revision for every expert
matching.training_recipe: identical optimizer, schedule, sequence length, batch convention, and checkpoint policy
matching.adapter_policy: LoRA or full-parameter fine-tuning must be recorded; no unrecorded mixture of policies

experts.readiness_note: These are compatibility-pilot experts, not strong publication experts. Spanish and Chinese donor exact match only rises from 0.03125 to 0.0625. Swahili donor gain is zero.

utility_probe.name: P_util
utility_probe.labels: numeric answer inherited from the English source
utility_probe.label_use: only to define a differentiable teacher-forced utility readout; never used for selection evaluation

risk_probe.name: P_risk
risk_probe.source: target-language passages paired with translations into donor language

certificate_calibration.name: C
certificate_calibration.use: drift certificate only after certify_drift() is applied; the raw rate is empirical drift

development.name: MGSM-dev
development.source: target-language development slice derived from MGSM
development.use: exhaustive E1 window sweep only; never used to tune probes or tau after inspection

readiness_host.name: readiness_host
readiness_host.use: host non-degeneracy and target_language_nonempty_check; not Belebele or knowledge retention

test.name: MGSM-test
test.use: untouched; blocked after the Spanish stop

metrics.utility: mean teacher-forced log-probability change for the target answer token(s)
metrics.risk: mean target-language versus donor-language log-probability margin change

statistics.regret: paired bootstrap over item-aligned outcomes for the single measured run; do not average p-values across missing seeds
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm correction is reserved for a multi-language canonical panel that this contract no longer authorizes

P1.fixture: host plus small parameter noise fake donor

E1.stop_rule: stop broader experiments and investigate E2 if Spearman is below approximately 0.5 or regret is a large fraction of the achievable gain

minimum_changes_if_authorized: experts that pass materially stronger readiness thresholds
real retention benchmark such as Belebele or knowledge evaluation

environment.gpu_memory: 8192 MiB total; 4778 MiB free at freeze
environment.inference_backend: local Hugging Face checkpoint; no OpenRouter or external API

provenance.commit_policy: subsequent commits require explicit user request
provenance.script_integrity: SHA-256 manifest must be generated beside every run
provenance.historical_e1_manifest: preserved dirty-tree run_manifest.json; do not rerun E1 to clean it
provenance.anti_fabrication: unmeasured values remain absent or explicitly blocked; no RES slot may be filled from estimates

current_blockers: The exact requested Qwen3-1.7B (or exact Qwen2.5-1.5B) checkpoint is unavailable; all Tier-A results must name the selected Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct fallback.
The corrected Spanish seed-0 canonical E1 run is a predeclared stop: rank correlation is below 0.5 and regret is two times the achievable positive gain.
Metric-label corrections (retention vs nonempty check, empirical drift vs certificate) do not authorize scale-up.
Chinese and Swahili canonical E1 runs, expert seeds 1 and 2, and cross-language replication statistics are blocked by the Spanish stop; their earlier outputs remain preliminary.
The adapter tests and synthetic float64 P3 fixture remain plumbing-only and must not be cited as language-model evidence.
E2 regime diagnostics are complete for Spanish, Chinese, and Swahili; E3-E10 and Tier B are not authorized after the canonical E1 stop.
Any stronger-base follow-up is a new preregistered study, not a retry chosen after seeing this result.
